run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with a given input script path and task name
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers from atomic mass values using closest match within 0.1 tolerance
atomic_data_from_lammps_data: create an AtomicData object from LAMMPS atom positions, atomic numbers, cell, and periodicity data
check_input_script: check a LAMMPS input script for force field commands that would incorrectly add forces to MLIP predictions
FixExternalCallback: create a FixExternalCallback callable that computes MLIP forces and energy for LAMMPS external fix at each timestep
